h1.en: Theodolite illustrates the note on Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump
h1.zh: 「經緯儀」用来说明电动10系列混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Pumping Distance (Horizontal) is 25 m. Read each label with its own figure. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列混凝土泵的距离文字写成：水平输送距离是25 m。同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite. The image subject is SovietTheodolite. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Pumping Distance (Horizontal) is 25 m. The frame “Concrete mixer” shows Metered concrete truck and does not replace these entries. The sheet already separates them when it lists both. Main-unit weight is 400 kg. If a distance entry is missing on the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite。画面内容是SovietTheodolite。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列混凝土泵的距离文字写成：水平输送距离是25 m。管路沿程要克服摩擦，水平段和垂直升高不是同一项工作。电动10系列混凝土泵这一页如果少了某一距离格，就让它继续空着。

body.en: Read each label with its own figure. Pumping Distance (Horizontal) is 25 m. Hopper capacity is 0.1 m³. Subject: Metered concrete truck. Theoretical Output is 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa.
body.zh: 同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。最大骨料粒径 2 cm and below。理论输送量是21 m³/h，最大出口压力是23 MPa。

body.en: Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical entry is not filled from another model. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. Maximum aggregate size is 2 cm and below. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not read a metre figure off that frame. Neither entry is a metre.
body.zh: 画面「Concrete mixer」的主体是Metered 混凝土 truck，不能代替这些格子。主体：Metered 混凝土 truck。

question.en: Which distance text does Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 电动10系列混凝土泵标出了哪几句距离？

answer.en: Pumping Distance (Horizontal) is 25 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite.
answer.zh: 水平输送距离是25 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can horizontal and vertical be swapped?
question.zh: 水平和垂直可以对调吗？

answer.en: Only when the label itself puts them in that order. Keep the shown order. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite.
answer.zh: 只有标题本身写成那个顺序时才按那个顺序。保留写出来的次序。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 21 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是21 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodolite画面里印出的数字。
